# Webspresso

> Minimal, Zero-Dependency-Sprawl Express 5 SSR Framework for Node.js.

Webspresso combines file-based routing, server-side Nunjucks rendering, an intuitive Knex-based ORM with ambient `AsyncLocalStorage` transaction propagation, dual authentication (Session + JWT), zero-dependency streaming compression, graceful shutdown, and a customizable Mithril.js SPA Admin Panel.

---

## Core Guidelines & Architectural Rules

- **Target Runtime**: Node.js 20 LTS (`.nvmrc`). Native addons (`better-sqlite3`, `sharp`, `bcrypt`) target Node 20 ABI.
- **Zero External Dependencies Policy**: Core framework capabilities (Auth, JWT signing, Error handling, Compression, Shutdown, CORS) rely strictly on native Node.js standard modules (`crypto`, `path`, `fs`, `events`, `zlib`, `async_hooks`).
- **File-Based Routing**: `.njk` templates in `pages/` map to URL routes. Server data loading uses `async function load({ req, res, db, ctx })`.
- **Services Layer**: File-based auto-discovery in `services/`. Declarative Zod validation, auth role guards, and automatic ACID transaction propagation (`transaction: true`).
- **Ambient Transactions**: Knex transactions bind to `AsyncLocalStorage` (`core/orm/transaction.js`). Scoped repositories automatically detect active transactions without manual `trx` parameter passing.

### Getting Started
- [Installation](docs/getting-started/installation.md): Prerequisites, npx project scaffolding, CLI installation, and TypeScript support.
- [First Application](docs/getting-started/first-app.md): Building your first SSR page, data loader, JSON API endpoint, and service.

- [Deployment](docs/getting-started/deployment.md): Production builds, graceful shutdown, PM2 clustering, Docker containerization, and Nginx reverse proxy.

### Architecture & Concepts
- [System Architecture](docs/concepts/architecture.md): Layered architecture, subsystem boundaries, zero-dependency philosophy, and Mermaid diagrams.
- [Request Lifecycle](docs/concepts/request-lifecycle.md): End-to-end request trace from TCP socket to Nunjucks template rendering and streaming compression.
- [Service Execution Pipeline](docs/concepts/service-execution-pipeline.md): Input sanitization, Zod validation, auth guards, ambient transactions, memoization, and timeouts.
- [Ambient Transaction Propagation](docs/concepts/transaction-propagation.md): How `AsyncLocalStorage` manages ACID database transactions across nested services and repositories.

### Agent Deep Dives (.agents/)
- [Agent Guidelines & Master Index](AGENTS.md): Core coding rules, zero regression policy, and verification workflows.
- [Architecture & Boundaries](.agents/ARCHITECTURE.md): Structural overview and public contracts.
- [Services Layer](.agents/SERVICES.md): Service registry, schema validation, and RBAC guards.
- [ORM & Database Layer](.agents/ORM.md): `defineModel`, `zdb` schemas, repositories, scopes, and migrations.
- [Dual Authentication System](.agents/AUTH.md): Session cookies, stateless JWT rotation, and policy guards.
- [Admin Panel Customization](.agents/ADMIN.md): Custom Mithril.js SPA pages, field renderers, and dashboard widgets.
- [Plugin Ecosystem](.agents/PLUGINS.md): Reference guide for all 15 official built-in plugins.
- [Realtime Layer](.agents/REALTIME.md): Framework-agnostic WebSocket, SSE, and Socket.IO adapters.
- [Background Queue](.agents/QUEUE.md): In-memory, Knex DB, and Redis queue adapters.
- [Exceptions & Central Error Boundary](.agents/ERRORS.md): Framework exception classes and error boundary.
- [Graceful Shutdown](.agents/SHUTDOWN.md): Socket draining and reverse plugin disposers.
- [HTTP Response Compression](.agents/COMPRESSION.md): Streaming zlib Brotli/Gzip negotiation.
- [SSR Streaming](.agents/STREAMING.md): Chunked HTTP transfer and deferred loader slots.

## Canonical Public API Exports

```typescript
import {
  createApp,
  createDatabase,
  defineModel,
  defineService,
  zdb,
  errors,
  adminPanelPlugin,
  restResourcePlugin,
  corsPlugin,
  csrfPlugin,
  realtimePlugin,
  basicAuthPlugin,
  type WebspressoApplication,
  type Repository,
  type InferModel,
  type InferServiceInput,
  type InferServiceOutput,
} from 'webspresso';
```
